body:
The distinct FP32-estimate candidate with five exact restoring correction steps now has preserved compiler, complete emitted-graph, and ordinary executed-entry JIT evidence. Canonical source remains clean and pushed at `4498cc41168ad29fc4c111819a4cb7ccaa54a8bf`; this is a private prototype, not an adopted optimization.

- [Compiler producer `8078cfdd`](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/8078cfdda9afe5d7478be2c3727858746f22748a/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-restoring-compiler): original full normal Endpoint Slang/SSA, exact single proposal NoContraction annotation, unchanged scoped policy, assembly, validation and readback passed. 102 fixed and 636 consumed inputs; five shader products sealed. Final SPV SHA256 `93b2623d95fd98b68a60f254d3d9888cf884521f920396d7758ddfd9f922c40f`.
- [Graph/control evidence `ff2e0c7f`](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/ff2e0c7fd7504a28adc7baf4f0341ce2c3561c88/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-restoring-graph-review): one 4.615-second pure reader, 699 fixed/703 consumed inputs, three positive/75 graph-negative/two helper-negative source controls passed. Exact guards, all five residual/mask/digit steps, original prefix and complete fallback/common Round, all 23 non-Divide helper instances, closed control flow and all 10,418 assembler/readback instructions joined. Mutated modules were not independently assembled or validated.
- [Ordinary JIT and cost evidence `9854d68f`](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/9854d68f8cae7d507401e292fb3e074cd2046878/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-restoring-ordinary-jit-screen): one candidate capture passed in 24.841 seconds, sampled peak RSS 1,736,104 KiB; 914 fixed/920 consumed inputs unchanged. Unmodified canonical host, fresh 55 enabled-feature arguments (Int64 zero; supported Float64 enabled but unused), loaded SPV, ordinary pass/export/lookup/called-entry chain, all three provider birth/session/inode mappings and six complete live sections with defined relocations/uncovered bytes joined. Undefined callbacks were consistency checked only. Existing stock capture and host were reused, not rerun or rebuilt.

Actual native review decision: **COST_PREMISE_SURVIVES_UNPROVEN**. All six sites (8,8,1,1,8,8 lanes) have a guarded restoring correction with zero corrective integer DIV. The separate original fallback packets retain 32,32,4,4,32,32 scalar DIV and group skip branches; mixed groups can pay both correction and the full fallback. Whole-object integer DIV is back to stock's 191, versus 225 in the prior UDiv-correction candidate. Relative to stock, text grows 7,328 bytes, coroutine frame 448 bytes, fixed resume stack 96 bytes, static instructions 1,210 and static RSP/RBP-memory-operand instructions 77. These are countercosts, not measured dynamic traffic or a speed result. Root checked all 29 cost-input hashes and 89 IR/75 native instruction references.

No retained arithmetic executed in this canary, and no hit rate, numerical equivalence, benefit trial, adoption or scientific/platform/release qualification is claimed. The first FP32 compiler's historical false/exit1 remains preserved; the prior UDiv-correction cost result remains separately unproven, and the previous FP64 original benefit trial remains rejected. Completed restoring compiler/graph/JIT scratch was removed only after exact Git/archive/remote and retired-birth checks.

Next: source-prepare the unchanged 174,268-record/14-operation arithmetic gate and 697,072 expected words, with fresh candidate CPU code and the original numeric GPU object linked to canonical device/base objects. The primitive has its own complete helper/interface/local-size contract and does not inherit Endpoint-specific RTE lines. If arithmetic passes, repair the already identified full-profile adapter restrictions before any profile build: 13 named-divide modules and four previously inlined camera modules require scoped handling; the other 18 profiles remain excluded. Then require the original eight integrated controls and unchanged sole ABBA/three-repeat/four-slot 20+2 benefit gates before adoption.
scope: Compiler/graph/ordinary cost milestone and original next gates only, no numerical or performance/adoption claim.
